title: 自然资源一张图 TWM 核心角色标准契约

clauses.heading: parcel_current / 现状地类图斑
clauses.body_md: TWM role `parcel_current` maps to One Map tables DLTB and runtime target `parcel_current`.

clauses.heading: pbf / 永久基本农田
clauses.body_md: TWM role `pbf` maps to One Map tables YJJBNTTB, YJJBNT and runtime target `synthetic_pbf`.

standard_tables.table_alias_zh: 永久基本农田保护图斑

clauses.heading: eco_redline / 生态保护红线
clauses.body_md: TWM role `eco_redline` maps to One Map tables STBHHX, STBHHX and runtime target `synthetic_eco_redline`.

clauses.heading: urban_boundary / 城镇开发边界
clauses.body_md: TWM role `urban_boundary` maps to One Map tables CZKFBJ, CZKFBJ and runtime target `synthetic_urban_boundary`.

clauses.heading: planning_zone / 国土空间用途管制分区
clauses.body_md: TWM role `planning_zone` maps to One Map tables CZKFBJ and runtime target `synthetic_planning_zones`.

standard_tables.table_alias_zh: 城镇开发边界规划分区

clauses.heading: project / 建设项目空间范围
clauses.body_md: TWM role `project` maps to One Map tables XS_XMKJFW, LSYD_XMZDFW and runtime target `synthetic_projects`.

standard_tables.table_alias_zh: 临时用地项目占地范围

clauses.heading: approval / 用途管制审批记录
clauses.body_md: TWM role `approval` maps to One Map tables ZZ_NYDZYFW, ZZ_TDZSFW and runtime target `approval_records`.

clauses.heading: enforcement / 执法督察事件
clauses.body_md: TWM role `enforcement` maps to One Map tables WFDK, YGYSXZJSYDTB and runtime target `enforcement_events`.

standard_tables.table_alias_zh: 遥感疑似新增建设用地图斑

clauses.heading: metadata_vector / 矢量数据元数据
clauses.body_md: TWM role `metadata_vector` maps to One Map tables meta_VectorData and runtime target `metadata_vector`.
